senses.gloss: m. (contract. of צרצר, √צר, to be near; cmp. forms like זוטרא, כסוסטרא, גיסטרא &c.; cmp. Samar. איצטר, איצר a. צטרא for our w.) side, border. [Dan. VII, 5 שְׂטַר.] Targ. O. Ex. XXV, 12 (Y. צִי׳).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 13:17">Targ. Y. Num. XIII, 17</cite> <cite ref="R00289"><he>צטרא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 20:2">Targ. Y. Ex. XX, 2</cite>, sq.; a. fr.—Y. Snh. VII, 24ᶜ top <he>דין מן דין ס׳ וכ׳</he> one stands on this side (of the culprit) and one on the other side (contrad. to <he>מלפניו</he> a. <he>מלאחריו</he> standing in front and behind).
<cite ref="Shabbat 134a">Sabb. 134ᵃ</cite> <he>ליפניה לסִיטְרֵיה וכ׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8) let him turn its hem upwards (outside).
